Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/15301

Problem Summary: In Next(), the merge join does not compeletly consume the inner tuples

What's Changed:

issue_context.title: executor: MergeJoin error

review_comments:
Hi, After a glance at the implementations of `tryToMatchInners `, each of them exits either when `innerIter.Current() == innerIter.End()` or `req.IsFull()`

So I think this loop definitely runs once, which is not necessary.
please note `numToAppend` which limits the matched inners.
you can also check the implementation in hash joins.
If `numToAppend` is 0, `chk.IsFull()` would be true. Then breaks this loop in line 367
